name: God Helmet classic (Persinger 2-phase)
summary: Persinger's procedure as described by Todd Murphy: ~25 min of a chirp over the RIGHT hemisphere only, then an abrupt switch to the amygdala burst-firing signal over both temporal lobes. Phase 1 can cause fear; press Skip to go to phase 2 at once. Dark, quiet room, blindfold, eyes closed.
source: Murphy, Enlightenment lecture https://youtu.be/zqrpKUTMXgY?t=1481 ; Deja vu lecture https://youtu.be/KJIAHHB8Btk?t=3737 ; Murphy-Balbin interview https://youtu.be/1uVjHmi51HM?t=1290 ; https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/god-helmet/index.htm
